moduleTitle: Travel and tourism, including places of interest

note.title: Travel and tourism, including places of interest
note.specFocus: Travel, transport, holidays, accommodation, weather, tourist attractions, local regions, booking, problems, cultural experiences, and future trips.
note.sourcePages: Original GCSE Spanish revision material; it is not an official AQA paper, mark scheme, or copied publisher content.
note.summary:
Travel and tourism, including places of interest

Key vocabulary
- el viaje; alojarse; la pensión; reservar; la recepción; el billete de ida y vuelta; retrasado; perder; el equipaje; el monumento; la excursión; alojarse; alojamientos rurales

Key grammar
- Use ir de vacaciones a, viajar en, quedar(se) for accommodation, the preterite for completed holidays, and imperfect for background or accommodation descriptions. Use indirect object pronouns for travel services.

Exam tips
- Use hace with weather when it was: hacía calor. Follow en in transport phrases with no article (en tren), and give a reaction to a travel problem.

questions.examTip: Build a short description, an opinion with porque and a personal or hypothetical comment.

En la foto se ve una familia que consulta un plano frente a un monumento. Las personas parecen concentradas y de buen humor. A mi parecer, esta situación es positiva porque muestra algo importante sobre los viajes, el turismo y los lugares de interés. Además, me gustaría participar porque sería una experiencia útil y memorable.

(English: In the photo I can see a family looking at a map in front of a monument. The people seem focused and in good spirits. In my opinion, this situation is positive because it shows something important about the topic. I would also like to take part because it would be useful and memorable.)

questions.examTip: Cover all bullets and keep speaking; an opinion plus reason is better than a long but unfinished sentence.
questions.modelAnswer:
— El verano pasado viajé a Sevilla en tren y visité la catedral. A mi modo de ver es importante porque tiene ventajas para mí y para otras personas. — (Unexpected question) Mi excursión favorita fue un paseo por el casco antiguo.

(English: — Last summer I travelled to Seville by train and visited the cathedral. In my view it is important because it has benefits for me and other people. — My favourite excursion was a walk through the old town.)
